components.prompt: A guest says their drink tastes flat and syrupy. What's the fix?

options.text: Add more of the base spirit
options.explanation: More base adds strength, not brightness. Still syrupy.
Yes. Acid is the lever that cuts sweetness.
That's the opposite direction; sweet is already too high.
Dilution weakens everything but keeps the same sweet-to-sour ratio.

items.text: Mix 2:1:1 with cold tea as the base
Taste, then add a squeeze of lime
